Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 1024x1536 portrait page for the Spanish fantasy comic 'Dos Parkinson y Medio'. Match warm expressive colorful cartoon ink-and-paint art from the references. Cream gutters, black panel borders, large legible Spanish text with correct accents. Western reading order. Only quoted script words appear. Narration in cream rectangular captions, speech in white balloons with tails clearly pointing to the NAMED speaker. Split alternating turns into separate small panels if needed; do not duplicate a character in one undivided panel.
Hermione: very voluminous curly brown hair, brown eyes, freckles, burgundy/gold uniform. Pansy: chin-length straight BLACK bob, GREEN eyes, green/silver uniform. Both have closed long school cloaks over opaque collared uniforms, natural seated poses.
NEW ADULT CHARACTER ELSIE TANNER: kind middle-aged woman with silver-gray wavy hair pinned in a low bun, oval spectacles, BLUE eyes, navy-blue high-neck full-length professional wizard robe, small sapphire eagle pendant. Mature adult facial features; not a student. All subsequent pages must preserve this character design.
LOCATION: her quiet magical office, cerulean BLUE walls, thick curtains, wood desk, leather-bound books, colored potion bottles, magical herb and botanical charts, softly glowing enchanted lamps. No examination, no reproductive diagrams, no physical infants. This page is only three fully clothed characters talking about a school assignment. References supply pupil identities, style and adult blue professional robe only; do not copy their settings or texts.

Small header exactly 'Capítulo 3 · 01'. Six sequential scenes. Include the chapter title in the first scenic panel exactly 'La serpiente y el tejón inflable'.
SCENE SCRIPT:
1. Cartela de capítulo: «La serpiente y el tejón inflable». Vista del despacho de Elsie Tanner: paredes azul cerúleo, cortinas gruesas, libros antiguos, frascos de pociones, plantas mágicas y esquemas botánicos animados. No ilustrar notas de autora ni diagramas reproductivos.
2. Hermione y Pansy esperan sentadas frente a un escritorio de madera. Hermione está inquieta; Pansy observa los objetos con curiosidad. Ambas siguen con sus uniformes y capas.
3. Elsie Tanner, medimaga adulta de cabello gris recogido, gafas ovaladas y túnica azul de cuello alto, lee las anotaciones de un expediente.
4. Hermione y Pansy intercambian una mirada. Cartela: «Reconocieron la letra de McGonagall.»
5. Elsie deja el pergamino: «Así que se metieron en este lío por un castigo.» Pansy responde: «Sí, algo así.»
6. Elsie sonríe cómplice: «Tendremos que esforzarnos un poco más. No queremos que McGonagall se enoje aún más. Es una mujer despiadada.» Pansy pregunta interesada: «¿La conoces?»
